summary: DoubleDown Interactive Co., Ltd., a Seoul-based gaming company listed on Nasdaq, furnished a routine Form 6-K under the 1934 Act containing its interim financial statements for the quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The filing consists of XBRL-tagged IFRS balance sheet, equity, and financial-instrument note data covering issued capital, share premium, retained earnings, noncontrolling interests, and fair-value classifications of cash and receivables. No transaction, ownership change, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situations event is disclosed. There are no deal terms, premium, or regulatory clocks; the item is ordinary periodic reporting, not arbitrageable.
